finalReport.rawFindings:
--- CRITICAL FINDINGS ---

[EVT-1] Hourly job only processes few symbols (backlog risk)
File: src/inngest/functions/fetch-closing-prices.ts (L1-L300)
Evidence: The cron handler queries ClosingToBeFetched PENDING entries with take: config.maxSymbolsPerJob (default from loadBatchConfig = 10) and then processes each entry sequentially. Producers (trade creation / tracking) can add many PENDING rows faster than 10/hour is consumed.  
Impact: A 10x spike in producers will create an unbounded backlog (queue growth) that the hourly job cannot drain, causing long delays, heavier replays/retries and likely provider-side throttling.  
Fix: Increase parallelism (process entries concurrently), raise maxSymbolsPerJob, split work into per-symbol jobs (enqueue one Inngest job per symbol), or run more frequent/sliced jobs.

[EVT-2] Per-trade emits with no throttling or batching
File: actions/trade.ts (L300-L420)
Evidence: addTrade() calls inngest.send() for trade/symbol.validate and closing-price/track-missing-data immediately for every created trade (no batching, no rate limit, no enqueue dedupe).  
Impact: A 10x surge in trade creation floods the event ingress (many Inngest events), overwhelming consumers and DB writes (ClosingToBeFetched upserts), causing backlog, consumer lag, and risk of provider retry storms or transient failures.  
Fix: Replace fire-and-forget per-trade sends with a batching/outbox pattern or rate-limited aggregator (batch up events per user/time and emit one consolidated job), or throttle producers.

[EVT-3] Infinite/uncapped retry on 429 from external API
File: lib/closing-price-fetch-utils.ts (L140-L260)
Evidence: fetchFromGrowwAPI detects 429, sleeps then calls return fetchFromGrowwAPI(request, retryAfterDelay) again with no retry-count limit (recursive retry loop).  
Impact: On API rate-limits or prolonged Groww outages a single Inngest step can loop indefinitely/block, consuming worker time and amplifying load (retry storm), causing other jobs to queue/timeout under a 10x spike.  
Fix: Add a bounded retry policy with exponential backoff and max attempts, surface failures to the job so it can mark entry FAILED and move to a DLQ.

--- WARNING FINDINGS ---

[EVT-4] Failed entries not surfaced to a proper DLQ
File: src/inngest/functions/fetch-closing-prices.ts (L300-L680)
Evidence: processEntry marks entries FAILED on total failure and handlePartialSuccess creates new PENDING parts, but there is no dead-letter table/alerting or automated retry-once-exhausted path.  
Impact: Poison or repeatedly-failing entries can silently accumulate/stop progress; during a 10x spike failed items can obscure real backlog and require manual inspection.  
Fix: Add a DeadLetter table/flag, emit an alert/event when status transitions to FAILED after N attempts, and surface metrics for oldest PENDING/FAILED age.

[EVT-5] Symbol validation jobs call external APIs without dedupe
File: src/inngest/functions/validate-symbol.ts & actions/validate-symbols.ts (L1-L220)
Evidence: validate-symbol handler calls external Groww endpoints and storeValidationResults uses upserts (DB-safe), but there is no processed-event dedupe or recent-run check before calling external APIs.  
Impact: A 10x spike of identical validation events will create many redundant external requests (rate-limit pressure) and waste worker capacity, increasing consumer lag (though DB upserts mitigate record duplication).  
Fix: Add a short-lived processed-events cache or last-validated timestamp check before making external calls (skip if recently validated), and/or coalesce duplicate validation requests. 

--- INFO ---

[EVT-6] Inngest step.run / step.sleep used for step isolation
File: src/inngest/functions/* (inngest functions)
Evidence: Functions use step.run and step.sleep which enables granular step retries and rate spacing (good for observability).
